{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Sentinel value (-1) in customer_age:", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values in customer_age:", sales_df['customer_age'].isnull().sum())

# Check value counts for key columns
print("\nChannel value counts:\n", sales_df['channel'].value_counts())
print("\nCustomer segment value counts:\n", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())
print("\nStatus value counts:\n", sales_df['status'].value_counts())
print("\nConverted value counts:\n", sales_df['converted'].value_counts())

# Check if any orders have status 'refunded' but converted = 1
refunded_but_converted = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'refunded') & (sales_df['converted'] == 1)]
print(f"\nOrders with status 'refunded' but converted = 1: {len(refunded_but_converted)}")"}
